$comment: Provider pack: docling layout-aware document extraction (complex tables, multi-column, scanned PDFs where markitdown returns garbage). Deep-merged by deploy/merge-packs.mjs when the user passes --enable-pack docling (v2 shape: mcp.servers.<name>.disabled:false + permissions array rule). --enable-pack docling also installs the runtime declared in the install block below (generic install_pack_runtime; ~3-4 GB with models from huggingface.co on first convert). Appends the permissions rule {"action": "docling*", "resource": "*", "effect": "allow"} so the merge flips the shipped deny.
$install-notes: docling-mcp[local] pins local conversion (DOCLING_CONVERSION_MODE=local in the server env). First convert downloads ~hundreds of MB of models from huggingface.co, cached thereafter. Install is heavy (~3-4 GB) — only runs when the pack is explicitly requested.
